why: Drops the one thing the label cannot show and the player cannot deduce. A session builds its renderer once, and two knobs in the preset cannot move afterwards at all (a GL context's antialias is fixed at creation, and `low` decides whether the muzzle-smoke system was ever constructed), so a change made mid-match lands on the next one. Without the sentence the control reads as broken in precisely the case it exists for: paused, mid-match, on a device that is struggling. Cheap to lose in a tidy-up, since the hint still describes the preset correctly.
killedBy: hud: the quality toggle (issue #540) says WHEN the choice takes effect, which the label cannot show
